title: The most capable AI assistant that works while you’re off running the world.
excerpt: An AI assistant at a dedicated email address. CC it, forward to it, set it on a routine. No app, no plugin. Free for 14 days.
content_html:
Deck is live on Product Hunt.Deck just launched on Product Hunt.Join usJoin the conversation

Ask Deck what it could take off your plate.

Tell us what keeps slipping through the cracks, and see where Deck fits.

Want to read more about Deck Email?

Read our original May announcement

Just one email away for the hundred
little things that pile up.

The more your assistant works alongside you, the more it learns to take off your plate.

Listens.

Copy your assistant on any thread. It follows along and quietly flags what needs your attention.

Learns.

Your assistant learns your preferences, your priorities, and the people you work with as it goes.

Remembers.

Files, decisions, and details stay in context, ready when you need them.

Acts.

Hand off a task or set a routine. Your assistant does the work and emails you the result.

How your email assistant works with you.

CC or forward emails to Deck. More ways to connect are coming soon.

Give your assistant a name and it gets an email address of its own.

Call it whatever fits. It gets its own email address, so reaching it is as easy as messaging a coworker.

You choose your assistant's name

@agent.hellodeck.ai

Your assistant is always available, so you don't have to be.

It checks in throughout your day and gives you a heads up on everything on your plate.

Vigil9:14 AM

Jeremy hasn't replied to your pricing note in 5 days. Want me to draft a follow-up?

Your assistant keeps track of how you work.

How you write, who's important, what to guard. Tell your assistant once and it shows up in everything it does for you.

I'm juggling a busy team and a dog who thinks he runs the place. Keep things short and warm, guard my evenings, and flag anything from the board the second it lands.

Set up routines that run on your schedule.

Tell your assistant what you want handled on a schedule: a brief of the day’s meetings, a weekly read on an account, a watch on a competitor. It runs the research and emails you the result.

CC your assistant on a thread, or ask it directly.

It catches up on its own and gives you another set of eyes in the conversation.

It only ever replies to you.It only ever replies to you, never anyone else on the thread.

Ask a question or hand off a task, it does the work.

Your assistant can connect the dots across your tools, line up what's next and tie up loose ends.

You'll forget how you worked

without it.

Think of it as a notetaker for your whole life. Every thread, file, and detail stays remembered and ready the moment you need it.

20 hours

a week go to email and finding information.

Enterprise-grade security · SOC 2 & GDPR · Never trained on your data

Helping busy people get more done in the hours they already have.

14-day free trial on Pro. No credit card. Cancel anytime.

  • No credit card to start
  • Cancel anytime
  • Replies only to you
  • SOC 2 + GDPR
